versions.content: Service ID authentication check for UDS service requests Upon processing a diagnostic service, the Dcm shall grant access to the diagnos- tic service if: 1. a DcmDsdServiceRole is configured for that service and the verification accord- ing to [SWS_Dcm_01522] was successful or 2. the active white list on that connection has one entry for a SID (1-byte element) which matches that service.
